sections.title: 05  The island and its open bay

changes: README.md, under how this port departs from the original.

local_checks.terrain: work/compare_terrain.py in the catalogue folder: the original's global heights at 4 px/deg regenerate exactly from LDEM_4 and the GL0420A geoid, and its regional heights exactly when the geoid is evaluated at 4 px/deg and interpolated to 16, as geography.topography.height_above_geoid does. terrain.py evaluates the geoid at the 16 px/deg centres, as the island study does, which moves heights by at most 0.49 m (mean 0.0002 m); the common water level from the island study's product moves them 0.037 m. The island taken from the product's summit is the original's island, all 22,869 pixels.
local_checks.film: Frames at 0, 22 and 43.9 s rendered at full size differ from the original film's frames by a mean of 1.4-2.9 of 255 levels over the scene, the larger differences along band edges, contours and coasts, where the H.264 coding and the half-texel correction act; the captions differ by design.
local_checks.renderer: moderngl 5.13.0 through EGL on Mesa Intel UHD Graphics (TGL GT1).
